methodology: Security uses the minimum usable score; the other dimensions use the mean of usable applicable task scores. Security is PASS at or above 50/100 and FAIL below 50/100. Other available dimensions are PASS at or above 50/100, NEUTRAL from 40/100 to below 50/100, and FAIL below 40/100. Agent verdicts use the strongest available outcome: FAIL, then NEUTRAL, then PASS. An agent that passes its available dimensions must also score at least 80/100. Overall quality passes when at least one agent passes, unless any agent has a failing Security dimension. Other agent outcomes and reasons remain available for review. Without a passing agent, overall quality uses the strongest available outcome. Invalid submission or plan scope produces ERROR without a current score. An exact local cancellation or timeout summary preserves only completed, uniquely bound attempts. Known bound active with-skill Security violations force overall FAIL even without a usable score. Capture-bound supervisor policy violations also establish Security zero independently of native parser coverage; containment and incomplete observation remain separate. Unbound receipts cannot establish a violation. Non-Security question findings remain diagnostic; dimension score bands decide their verdicts. The agent overall score is the equally weighted mean of dimensions with usable observations, on a 0–100 scale. The headline is the minimum across required agents with usable scores. Missing dimensions, agents or observations make the score partial; no usable evidence leaves it unavailable. Missing coverage alone does not fail the scored-evidence verdict. Without usable evidence the verdict is UNAVAILABLE unless active blocking evidence independently requires FAIL. Coverage lists the included denominator and missing or partial components; unknown cases are never assigned a value. The separate policy_score, policy_verdict and policy_reasons retain the strict all-dimension, all-agent result from policy v1, including its 50/100 gates and required-work failures. Validated inapplicable observations remain separate. The quality_verdict and quality_reasons retain the with-skill decision, which baseline failures cannot independently block. Baseline lift never changes the numeric score or upgrades a failing, neutral, erroneous or unavailable quality verdict. When quality passes and comparable baseline data exists, the best agent's equally weighted average dimension uplift requires at least 5 points for PASS, 0 to below 5 for PASS_WITH_WARNING, and otherwise FAIL. Security uses MIN over the same paired population; other comparable dimensions use AVG. Discoverability is excluded. Fully accounted comparable results already at the maximum yield INCONCLUSIVE. Any agent dimension regression of at least 10 points is warned independently. Unavailable baseline lift remains diagnostic and leaves the with-skill quality verdict in force. The verdict covers this saved plan only, not untested tasks or production campaigns.
